summary: Page 13, mostly stock quotations and local briefs. Target story reports that 'Ironsides Echo,' the monthly student newspaper of the Bordentown Manual Training and Industrial School (the state school for Black youth in Bordentown, NJ), won two second-place awards in the 16th annual Columbia University scholastic press contest for student newspapers and magazines. Adjacent item reports a movie, 'Let My People Go,' featuring the Tuskegee Choir, was shown at Bordentown's A.M.E. Church for a meeting of a Black community group running a cleanup campaign.
